articles.title: Indore: 5 Policemen Suspended After Businessman Alleges Illegal Entry, Assault & Gold Theft
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major controversy has surfaced in Madhya Pradesh’s Indore, where five police personnel, including a Sub-Inspector, have been suspended in connection with serious allegations made by a local businessman in the Lasudia area.

body.html:
A major controversy has surfaced in Madhya Pradesh’s Indore, where five police personnel, including a Sub-Inspector, have been suspended in connection with serious allegations made by a local businessman in the Lasudia area.

The action was taken by the DCP following a complaint by businessman Gaurav Jain, who accused police officials of illegally entry, assault, and theft during the execution of a warrant linked to a property dispute.

Allegations of Illegal Entry and Theft:
According to Jain, on April 1, police personnel — identified as SIs Sanjay Vishnoi, Ranveer Kushwah, Praneet Bhadoria, Dinesh Gurjar, and Deependra Mishra — entered his house without proper procedure. He alleged that the officers switched off CCTV cameras, used a master key to unlock the premises, and conducted a search.

During this time, Jain claims that over 22 tolas of gold went missing from his house.

Detention and Alleged Assault:
Jain further alleged that he was detained at Lasudia police station from the night of April 1 to April 2. He was then taken to Gwalior in a private vehicle. Instead of being kept at a police facility, he claims he was held in a private guest house on April 3, where he was allegedly assaulted by associates of a retired ACP linked to the case.

He later secured bail from a court and returned to Indore.

Money Extortion Claims:
The businessman also accused a policeman, Rakesh Sharma, of taking ₹27,000 from him — ₹10,000 via a QR code payment at a hotel opposite the police station, and ₹17,000 transferred to his son’s account.

Complaint and Police Action:
Jain submitted a formal complaint along with audio recordings to Police Commissioner Santosh Singh and DCP Kumar Prateek on April 16. Following an internal probe led by ACP Parag Saini, evidence reportedly supported the allegations, leading to the suspension of the five officers.

Police Response:
One of the accused officers, SI Sanjay Vishnoi, has denied all allegations, stating that the action was conducted lawfully and in accordance with procedure. He termed the complainant a “conspirator” and claimed that proper intimation had been given to senior officials.

Background of Dispute:
The case is reportedly linked to a financial dispute. Jain stated that he had prior dealings with a retired ACP, including a ₹20 lakh loan in 2023, which was repaid. However, a later transaction of ₹65 lakh involving other associates led to disputes and bounced cheques, eventually resulting in legal action.

Legal Perspective:
Legal experts have pointed out that while police are authorised to execute warrants, they must follow due process, including proper documentation in panchnama and station records. Any deviation, especially involving alleged misconduct or property tampering, can invite strict action.

Next Steps:
The businessman has stated that mere suspension is not sufficient and has demanded the registration of an FIR. He has warned that he will escalate the matter to the DGP and Chief Minister if further action is not taken.

The case has raised serious questions about police conduct and accountability, with further investigation underway.

#indore #policeaction #madhyapradesh #breakingnews #policeaccountability

articles.title: Jalaun Shocker: Councillors Accused of Brutally Assaulting Labourer
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing case of alleged high-handedness by local councillors has surfaced in Uttar Pradesh’s Jalaun district, after a video showing a labourer being brutally assaulted went viral on social media.

body.html:
A disturbing case of alleged high-handedness by local councillors has surfaced in Uttar Pradesh’s Jalaun district, after a video showing a labourer being brutally assaulted went viral on social media.

The incident reportedly took place at the Martyr’s Memorial Complex on Jhansi Road, under the Orai Kothwali police station area, where construction work was underway. According to reports, a dispute broke out between a labourer and some councillors over an unspecified issue.

As the argument escalated, the councillors allegedly assaulted the labourer, throwing him to the ground and beating him in full public view. Eyewitnesses claimed that people present at the spot attempted to intervene, but were unable to stop the accused.

The entire incident was captured on video by a bystander, and the footage is now circulating widely online, triggering anger among locals.

In a more serious allegation, after the assault, the councillors forcibly pushed the injured labourer into a car and took him away from the scene.

The incident, occurring in a public place, has created an atmosphere of fear and outrage in the area. Locals are demanding a fair and impartial investigation, along with strict action against those involved.

Police are investigating the matter.

articles.title: Navi Mumbai Shocker: RTO Officer Caught on Camera Assaulting Bus Driver
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident of alleged brutality by an RTO officer has surfaced from Navi Mumbai, after a video showing a bus driver being assaulted went viral on social media. The incident took place near the McDonald’s outlet on the Mumbai–Pune Expressway in Kalamboli.

body.html:
A shocking incident of alleged brutality by an RTO officer has surfaced from Navi Mumbai, after a video showing a bus driver being assaulted went viral on social media.

The incident took place near the McDonald’s outlet on the Mumbai–Pune Expressway in Kalamboli. According to the bus driver, the RTO officer approached him aggressively while he was attempting to manoeuvre the vehicle to the side and began beating him, accusing the driver of trying to run him over.

CCTV footage from inside the driver’s cabin reportedly captured the entire sequence. The visuals show the officer stopping the bus and confronting the driver before the situation escalated into physical assault. The driver claimed that even after he complied and began moving the bus aside, the officer continued to beat him, including after he stepped out of the vehicle.

The area near Kalamboli is known as a major halt point for private buses and travel vehicles, especially at night, with many passengers boarding buses from the highway stretch after the airport route. The incident has raised concerns among frequent travellers and drivers operating in the region.

Following the video’s circulation, strong reactions have emerged from the public in Navi Mumbai. While many have criticised the alleged high-handed behaviour of the RTO official, calling it an abuse of power, others have pointed to reckless driving by some bus operators as a possible trigger for such confrontations.

Meanwhile, the RTO officer has defended his actions, claiming that the driver attempted to run him over, prompting his response.

No official statement has been released so far, and the incident has sparked a wider debate on accountability and conduct of enforcement authorities on highways.

articles.title: ‘No Shaadi Card, No Entry’ – Man Rams Tractor Into Wedding Lawn After Being Snubbed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Shahjahanpur, UP: In a shocking late-night drama at a marriage lawn in Miranpur Katra, a young man allegedly went on a rampage with his tractor – all because he was not invited to a wedding. The incident took place late Sunday night on the Katra-Khudaganj highway.

body.html:
Shahjahanpur, UP: In a shocking late-night drama at a marriage lawn in Miranpur Katra, a young man allegedly went on a rampage with his tractor – all because he was not invited to a wedding.

The incident took place late Sunday night on the Katra-Khudaganj highway. According to reports, the man, a local resident, became furious after realising that while he was left out, his wife had been invited and was attending the ceremony from the groom’s side.

Around 12 am, the accused reached the wedding venue in an agitated state and deliberately rammed his tractor into the main gate, smashing it completely. The entire act was captured on the lawn’s CCTV cameras.

Local police rushed to the spot after getting information and brought the situation under control. Following talks between both parties late that night, a compromise was reached.

Inspector Awadhesh Singh of Miranpur Katra police station confirmed that no written complaint or statement was received, and therefore no legal action was taken after the matter was resolved amicably.

#WeddingDrama #TractorRampage #ShahjahanpurNews #NoInviteNoEntry #UPUncensored

articles.title: Stolen Car Rampage in Ludhiana: Police Chase Ends After Baleno Smashes 7 Vehicles
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chaos broke out in the Shimlapuri area of Ludhiana on Sunday morning after a speeding white Baleno car rammed multiple vehicles while attempting to evade the police. The incident, which was not a routine road accident, occurred during a chase following a car theft complaint.

body.html:
Chaos broke out in the Shimlapuri area of Ludhiana on Sunday morning after a speeding white Baleno car rammed multiple vehicles while attempting to evade the police. The incident, which was not a routine road accident, occurred during a chase following a car theft complaint.

According to reports, police had received information about a stolen Baleno from the Shimlapuri area and had laid a trap to intercept the vehicle. At around 11:30 am, when police signalled the car to stop, the driver allegedly accelerated instead of complying and attempted to flee.

During the chase through narrow lanes near the Dussehra Ground, the accused drove recklessly and lost control of the vehicle. In the process, the car hit a Bullet motorcycle, a 100cc bike, two Activa scooters, an auto-rickshaw, and also damaged two parked vehicles. The vehicle then rammed into a house wall before crashing into an electric pole with such force that the pole snapped into two.

Accused Apprehended Near Dussehra Ground

Following the crash, the vehicle was badly damaged. Police personnel on the spot acted promptly and apprehended the accused near the Dussehra Ground. The SHO confirmed that the accused was being chased in connection with a car theft case and had caused damage to several vehicles while attempting to escape.

The accused has been taken into custody and shifted to the concerned police station. Further investigation is underway to ascertain whether others were involved in the theft.

Despite the scale of the incident, no casualties were reported. However, several vehicles were damaged, causing significant losses to owners.

A video of the incident shows two policemen on a motorcycle chasing the suspect vehicle. As the police approached, the driver suddenly reversed the car, crushing multiple parked bikes. People present at the spot were seen running to safety.

The accused reportedly swerved the vehicle multiple times, creating panic in the area. The chase ended when the police surrounded the car while the driver was attempting to reverse, and overpowered him.

#Ludhiana #PunjabPolice #CarTheft #HitAndRun #RoadRampage

articles.title: Blaze Before Big Day: Fire Erupts at Pachpadra Refinery Ahead of PM Visit
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A massive fire broke out at the Pachpadra Refinery in Rajasthan’s Balotra district on Monday, triggering panic just a day before Prime Minister Narendra Modi was scheduled to inaugurate the facility on April 21.

body.html:
A massive fire broke out at the Pachpadra Refinery in Rajasthan’s Balotra district on Monday, triggering panic just a day before Prime Minister Narendra Modi was scheduled to inaugurate the facility on April 21.

According to preliminary information, the fire erupted in one of the refinery’s processing units. Thick plumes of smoke were visible from nearly a kilometre away, indicating the intensity of the blaze. However, no casualties have been reported so far.

More than 20 fire tenders were rushed to the spot, and firefighting teams launched a large-scale operation to contain the flames and prevent them from spreading to other units. Technical experts and security agencies have also reached the site to assess the situation and determine the cause of the fire, which remains unknown.

The incident has put the administration on high alert. BJP district president Bharat Modi said that entry into the refinery premises has been restricted, and the situation appears to be under control from the outside. He added that Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma is expected to visit the site to review the situation.

Reacting to the development, former Rajasthan Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot expressed concern, calling the refinery a “proud project” for the state and terming the incident unfortunate, especially with the inauguration scheduled the next day.

Authorities said their immediate priority is to fully contain the fire and ensure safety within the refinery. The incident has also raised concerns over whether the scheduled inauguration programme will proceed as planned.

#Rajasthan #RefineryFire #Balotra #BreakingNews #IndustrialAccident

articles.title: “Namaz on Road Lands Man in Jail” Viral Video Triggers Police Action in UP’s Rampur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Rampur: A young man was arrested in Uttar Pradesh’s Rampur district after a video showing him offering namaz in the middle of a busy road went viral on social media.

body.html:
Rampur: A young man was arrested in Uttar Pradesh’s Rampur district after a video showing him offering namaz in the middle of a busy road went viral on social media.

The incident reportedly took place at Shahbad Gate intersection under the Civil Lines police station area, where the man was seen praying on the road, leading to traffic disruption and a crowd gathering at the spot.

Taking cognisance of the viral video, police registered a case against the accused for obstructing a public place. The man, identified as Naeem (35), a resident of Dhavni Hasanpur in Bilaspur area and employed at a local hotel, was taken into custody and later sent to jail after being produced before a court.

Additional Superintendent of Police Anurag Singh confirmed the action, stating that the arrest was made after the video surfaced online. “A video from the Civil Lines area showed a man offering namaz in the middle of the road. Based on this, an FIR was registered and the accused has been arrested,” he said.

Police officials stated that such activities on public roads can disrupt traffic and impact law and order, which prompted immediate action.

The development comes amid ongoing enforcement measures in Uttar Pradesh to regulate religious activities in public spaces. Authorities have repeatedly emphasised that public roads cannot be used for religious practices without permission, especially if they cause inconvenience to the public.

At the same time, legal provisions distinguish between public and private spaces. Courts, including the Allahabad High Court, have clarified that while authorities can act against religious activities conducted on public roads, offering prayers within private premises remains protected under the right to religious freedom.

Meanwhile, reports suggest that some locals have claimed the accused may be mentally unstable. Police said this aspect is also being examined as part of the investigation.

Authorities have appealed to the public to carry out religious activities only at designated places to avoid disruption and maintain public order.

#Rampur #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #PoliceAction

articles.title: “Suit-Boot Chor at Wedding!” ₹5 Lakh Looted During Engagement in Noida Banquet Hall
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Noida: A theft incident during an engagement ceremony in Noida has raised serious concerns over security at public events.

body.html:
Noida: A theft incident during an engagement ceremony in Noida has raised serious concerns over security at public events. The incident took place at Diamond Crown Banquet Hall in Sector 49, where a man posing as a guest allegedly stole a bag containing around ₹5 lakh in cash and jewellery.

According to reports, the incident occurred around 1 pm while the ceremony was underway and both families were busy with celebrations. Taking advantage of the situation, a youth dressed in a formal suit entered the venue and blended in with the guests.

CCTV footage shows the accused moving around the hall casually and even having food at the function. After identifying a bag containing cash and jewellery belonging to the bride’s family, he discreetly picked it up and walked out of the venue without raising suspicion.

The theft came to light when family members noticed the bag was missing and began searching for it. Upon failing to locate it, they checked the banquet hall’s CCTV footage, which clearly captured the entire sequence of events.

Following the incident, a complaint was lodged at Sector 49 police station. Police officials said the case has been taken seriously and efforts are underway to identify and apprehend the accused using CCTV evidence.

The incident highlights lapses in security arrangements at large gatherings, where outsiders can easily gain access by posing as guests.

#Noida #Theft #CCTV #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: “28 Bribes for One Land Deal?” Cricketer’s Explosive Claim on Punjab System Sparks Uproar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chandigarh: Allegations of widespread corruption in Punjab’s land registration process have resurfaced after former national-level cricketer Pulkit Sharma claimed he was forced to pay bribes to multiple officials to complete a property transaction.

body.html:
Chandigarh: Allegations of widespread corruption in Punjab’s land registration process have resurfaced after former national-level cricketer Pulkit Sharma claimed he was forced to pay bribes to multiple officials to complete a property transaction.

Taking to X, Sharma alleged that despite having “fully legitimate” documents, he had to pay bribes to a tehsildar and over 28 others involved in the process.

In his post, Sharma described the system as deeply entrenched, claiming that “everyone has their rate fixed” and even a minor mistake could result in files being deliberately stalled. He termed the experience “shameful” and said that investing in Punjab felt “criminal” despite the transparency of the deal.

The post quickly went viral, triggering a wave of reactions on social media. While many users echoed concerns about alleged corruption and inefficiencies in government processes, others questioned the claims, stating that not all land registrations involve bribery and that such practices persist partly because people comply instead of reporting them.

Amid the growing controversy, Sharma reportedly stood by his allegations, further claiming that brokers operate openly outside tehsil offices and that officials often raise repeated objections or delay work to pressure applicants into making payments.

Meanwhile, Sharma’s account on X is currently unavailable, adding to speculation and debate online.

The incident has once again brought focus on alleged irregularities in land registration systems and the need for greater transparency and accountability in administrative processes.

#Punjab #Corruption #LandRegistration #BreakingNews #IndiaNews
